name: Switcher
description: Binary toggle control with thumb animation

checked.description: Controlled on/off setting. Parent updates do not emit change notifications.

defaultChecked.description: Uncontrolled initial setting, also restored by form reset.

label.description: Visible label. Empty content adds no label slot; zero remains visible.

truncate.description: Truncate overflowing label text with an ellipsis. By default the full label wraps.

aria-label.description: Accessible name, including when there is no visible label.

aria-labelledby.description: External label element IDs; takes native precedence over aria-label.

disabled.description: Exclude the switch from activation, focus navigation and form submission.

required.description: Require the on state for native form validation.

name.description: FormData key. An unnamed switch does not contribute a form field.

value.description: Value submitted only when on; it does not control the setting.

form.description: ID of an external native form that owns the input.

autoFocus.description: Focus the native input on mount.

fullWidth.description: Expand the membrane and clickable label to the container width.

membrane.description: Shared outer spacing; toggling it preserves input identity and state.

behavior.controlledValue: checked controls the binary setting. Parent updates and form reset do not emit user change notifications.
behavior.uncontrolledValue: defaultChecked initializes selection and is restored by form reset.
behavior.nativeEvents: Space and pointer activation use the native input. onChange runs first, then onCheckedChange, each once; preventDefault() in onClick or onChange cancels the activation and changes nothing.

aria.nativeElement: A visually hidden native input[type="checkbox"] with role="switch" remains focusable, accessible and participates in forms.
required: visible label or external accessible name
notes: The wrapping native label names the input. Explicit native aria-label/aria-labelledby override the visible label using browser naming precedence.
Switcher geometry is expressed through component-local aliases over shared control, space and membrane tokens.
Thumb transform and control opacity transitions consume shared Face UI motion tokens.
Visible label copy renders through the Face UI Text primitive while the native label part preserves form-control click semantics.
